# Native Mermaid source supplements

These files record independently reviewed source facts that an imported parser
model discards or normalizes. They are separate from the immutable upstream
capture under `../mermaid_terminal/`; production code never reads them.

`sequence_go_cohort.json` locks every one of the 101 Mermaid-ascii sequence IDs
and the complete vendor cases file hash. `sequence_go_facts.json` binds the raw
input and canonical sorted-key model hashes, exact UTF-8 byte witnesses for
participant/actor declarations and metadata, and source-reviewed display fields.
The header/comments-only parser-negative has no imported model; its canonical
absent-model fact is an empty object, not a rewritten upstream expectation.

The native sequence inventory test pins both supplement file hashes and checks
all IDs, source/model bindings, byte witnesses and canonical text. Source review
and frozen facts do not imply a successful rendering or an executed original
assertion. The complete native geometry and original-assertion results retain
separate outcomes, including every unimplemented positive.

`sequence_official_side_notes_facts.json` freezes eight distinct body-only
projections from Mermaid 12.2.0 commit
`1fb7869866dd619168d840291c9c54b4f129758b`. Agent `/root/corpus_oracle`
independently authored the source facts for 17 messages and nine notes, with
complete raw-input hashes, body byte offsets and body hashes. The native
`SourceReviewedOfficialSideNotes` gate checks these projections. The raw files
remain the source of truth; body geometry does not certify their frontmatter,
fonts, alignment options, look settings or foreign SVG appearance. Its file
SHA-256 is `9a5ce7dc8c5f98badaf5c6a86346d8acbf98f6088b3851c2ef7e6131d188e1c7`.

`merman_xy102_facts.json` preserves all 102 exact Merman XY source identities and
their C1-reviewed primary parser-model references, authored domain presence,
160 configuration applications, six band-tail transformations, three missing
band slots, and three text-normalization changes. It was deterministically
exported from source facts independently reviewed by agent `/root/corpus_review`;
the file retains the export-stage status as provenance. The reviewed export
SHA-256 is `eeb3c1508b25202838fb175fac8757e4428d2d41e76a0901b6373b04a3f3a3a8`.
The chart gate binds this hash to every vendor source/model reference. Geometry,
empty-state semantics and original foreign encoder/resource predicates require
their separate native gates; these source facts confer no rendering pass.

`er296_facts.json` freezes the complete ER corpus: 296 records / 293 exact
sources, including 294 drawing requirements and two records for the same
official valid-empty source. It binds the complete source/model/expectation
inventory. Stronger model projections are diagnostic; source C1 observation or
loading does not certify complete ER geometry or empty states. Complete
original predicates and source presentation properties remain pending. Agent
`/root/corpus_review` independently reviewed this source-only supplement, whose
SHA-256 is `44911ea88baad20091c642c3c1ca502050d30de46e50ae0185d86285958e4d44`.

Changes require independent source review and an explicit native hash update.
Neither test execution nor snapshot regeneration can update these files.
